notes.title: Trailer: Marsupilami: Hoobadventure’s first trailer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40605290/71ad25a49db33ae35ba962c07d0e226a06e4a751.png[/img]

Microids is delighted to unveil the first trailer for Marsupilami: Hoobadventure!

[previewyoutube=kn2_Zwvxl1o;full][/previewyoutube]

The three Marsupilamis Punch, Twister and Hope are on their way and will reach your gaming platform of choice November 16th. Get ready to travel through various environments and jump all over to save the animals from a terrible curse.
